title: Property Charge Advance Repayment Arrangement Schedule: Arrearage Bands and Installment Terms
content:
Under Property Charge Advance Repayment, each arrangement a borrower may hold carries an arrearage band and a number of monthly installments. The band is the range of arrearage, measured on the day the repayment agreement is issued, for which that arrangement is offered; a band maximum of 0.00 means the band has no upper limit.

## Schedule of bands and terms

| Arrangement | Arrearage band minimum (USD) | Arrearage band maximum (USD) | Monthly installments in the term | Installments paid under the arrangement |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lump-Sum Repayment | 0.01 | 0.00 (no upper limit) | 0 (no installments) | No |
| Repayment Plan - 12 Months | 0.01 | 3000.00 | 12 | Yes |
| Repayment Plan - 24 Months | 3000.01 | 6000.00 | 24 | Yes |
| Repayment Plan - 36 Months | 6000.01 | 9000.00 | 36 | Yes |
| Repayment Plan - 60 Months | 9000.01 | 0.00 (no upper limit) | 60 | Yes |
| At-Risk Extension | 0.01 | 0.00 (no upper limit) | 0 (no installments) | No |

## Terms common to every arrangement

| Term | Value in every arrangement |
|---|---|
| How the installment arrangement is chosen | The shortest term whose arrearage band covers the arrearage |
| Whether the borrower may choose a shorter plan than the band assigns | Yes |
| How the monthly installment is rounded | Rounded up to the cent, with the final installment adjusting to what remains |

## Reading the schedule

The four installment plans divide the arrearage into adjoining bands with no gap and no overlap: an arrearage of 3000.00 sits in the band of Repayment Plan - 12 Months, while 3000.01 sits in the band of Repayment Plan - 24 Months; 6000.00 and 6000.01, and 9000.00 and 9000.01, divide the next bands in the same way. Because the term is chosen as the shortest one whose band covers the arrearage, exactly one installment plan's band covers any arrearage of at least 0.01.

The Lump-Sum Repayment and the At-Risk Extension carry no installments, and their term is recorded as 0. Only the four Repayment Plan arrangements are paid by monthly installments.

### Hypothetical band readings

| Hypothetical arrearage on the issue day (USD) | Installment plan whose band covers it | Term |
|---|---|---|
| 1250.40 | Repayment Plan - 12 Months | 12 installments |
| 4800.00 | Repayment Plan - 24 Months | 24 installments |
| 7310.55 | Repayment Plan - 36 Months | 36 installments |
| 14020.00 | Repayment Plan - 60 Months | 60 installments |

These figures are illustrations only and are not drawn from any borrower's file.
